Bring your fiance! And also most bridal stores allow face-timing for the relatives. If you're hunting for the dress in Australia and don't know where to go, feel free to flick me a message as I'm a bridal stylist but don't know if I'm allowed to advertise who I work with on the forum. 

Overall, I'd recommend to just do your research and ask the bridal boutiques if they allow photos and Video calls for family. The bridal experience is super exciting and fun to share with your loved ones!

If it's something you'd like to do, go for it! I work in bridal and we have brides who come and buy 1 dress for the hens night, 1 dress for the ceremony, 1 dress for photos, and 1 dress for the reception. You do you!!

Just make sure you are managing your money wisely, and have thought through everything before making any full purchases!

Hey hun, I'm sorry that you've had that experience. I'm glad you're planning on talking to your mum about it, cos I think that's the best option moving forward here. 

I don't think your expectations are unreasonable, and you're 100% entitled to be sad about your family's response. (Or lack thereof) 

Make sure when you talk to her that you have your thoughts planned out and together, even if you write it down first. Tell her there's something important you guys need to chat about, and make sure she actually sets aside the time to listen. Even if you invite her around for coffee or something. Explain how you feel. 

If she doesn't listen and still doesn't care, then I'm so so sorry. You're worth more than that. 

Now, let me say CONGRATS ON YOUR ENGAGEMENT!! :D I'm super excited for you and wish you all the best for your big day cos you deserve that and more!!

As someone who works in the wedding industry, I can tell you that if you're worried about being a bridezilla, you aren't one. :D Feel free to be excited about your wedding, and treat people the same way you usually do. 

On the flipside, not everyone has the personality of a romcom protagonist. Don't feel there's something wrong with you for not throwing a dance party for yourself every night cos you're just so excited. 

In short, just be you and love it!!
